overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: four dissenting members acting on their own did not form a subcommittee, and the committee did not deliberate about the minority report outside a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that four committee members who wrote a dissenting minority report on a school project formed an unnoticed subcommittee subject to the law.
allegations.key_passage: We find that these four Committee members created the report on their own initiative.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee's members deliberated about the dissenting minority report outside a noticed meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Furthermore, the Committee did not deliberate about the minority report outside of a meeting.
